parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is excited to offer a 2-day seminar Multilevel and Growth Curve Models in R and Stata, running from February 12 - 13 by the UCL Department of Epidemiology and Public Health. This workshop provides a practical introduction to multilevel (mixed) models and growth curve analysis, essential for researchers working with hierarchical or longitudinal data. Participants will learn to specify and fit mixed models, interpret results, address missing data, and visualize outputs using R and Stata. With a balance of theory and hands-on examples, this seminar ensures attendees gain the skills needed to analyze complex data structures confidently in their own research.

Sign up today to secure your spot, and feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes
